liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (3 reviews): The reviewer says this song was a recurring theme for Jerry in his later years and hoped for a studio version; Jerry sings the ending with great force [2][6][7]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: So Many Roads [10]

## The recordings

- **gd92-02-13.sbd.rehearsal.samaritano.17404.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 1 songs; 5 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [1]

## Around the show

- The recording is a studio practice session, not a concert, so the show is a rehearsal [2]
- Says a few live versions hint at how strong the song was, pointing to 6-8-1992 [2]
- Names the 10-9-94 US Air performance as the best So Many Roads [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd92-02-13.sbd.rehearsal.samaritano.17404.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD->CD->EAC->SHN by Joe SamaritanoStudio Rehearsal of So Many Roads [1]
